stages.role_zh: 建议 Claude；也可由 Codex 负责
stages.role_en: Suggested: Claude; Codex can also lead
stages.input_zh: 玩法想法、目标玩家、设备、参考与现有代码约束
stages.input_en: Game idea, players, devices, references, and code constraints
stages.gate_zh: 规则无硬冲突，最小版本、素材契约与验收标准已由人类确认。
stages.gate_en: Human confirmation of feasible rules, minimum scope, art contracts, and acceptance criteria.
stages.return_zh: 规则或需求冲突留在策划阶段解决。
stages.return_en: Resolve rule or requirement conflicts in design.

stages.role_zh: 建议具备生图能力的 Codex；Claude 可整理工单和复核
stages.role_en: Suggested: Codex with image tools; Claude may brief and review
stages.input_zh: 已确认的 01-design.md、风格参考与素材范围
stages.input_en: Approved 01-design.md, visual references, and asset scope
stages.gate_zh: 所需素材真实存在并通过尺寸、留白、坐标与风格验收；清单区分候选与已接受状态。
stages.gate_en: Required assets exist and pass dimensions, reserved-space, coordinate, and style checks; manifest statuses are accurate.
stages.return_zh: 素材问题返工美术；空间或规则不可行则回策划。
stages.return_en: Rework assets in art; return infeasible spatial or rule constraints to design.

stages.role_zh: 建议 Codex；Claude 可按同一契约实现
stages.role_en: Suggested: Codex; Claude may implement the same contract
stages.input_zh: 已确认策划、已接受素材与清单、当前阶段允许修改的文件
stages.input_en: Approved design, accepted assets/manifest, and allowed files
stages.gate_zh: 可玩闭环与本轮验收项有实际证据，候选版本、改动与未验证项已记录。
stages.gate_en: Playable loop and stage checks have evidence; revision, changes, and verification gaps are recorded.
stages.return_zh: 代码问题在本阶段修复；契约缺口分别回策划或美术。
stages.return_en: Fix implementation defects here; route contract gaps to design or art.

stages.role_zh: 建议由另一会话中的 Claude 独立复核；也可互换
stages.role_en: Suggested: Claude in a separate review session; roles may be swapped
stages.input_zh: 前三阶段交付、候选版本、验收矩阵及人类真机反馈
stages.input_en: Earlier handoffs, candidate revision, acceptance matrix, and device feedback
stages.gate_zh: 无阻断项；关键未验证项已补证，真机与主观体验由人类确认。
stages.gate_en: No blockers; material gaps resolved; human confirmation of device and experiential criteria.
stages.return_zh: 逐项指派策划 / 美术 / 编码返工，再核验修复后的版本。
stages.return_en: Route findings to design/art/implementation and recheck the fixed revision.

stages.role_zh: 由具备仓库和目标服务器权限的指定会话执行
stages.role_en: A designated session with repository and target-host access
stages.input_zh: 通过的 04-acceptance.md、同一候选版本、精确目标与本轮提交 / 推送 / 部署授权
stages.input_en: Passing 04-acceptance.md, matching candidate, exact targets, and explicit commit/push/deploy scope
stages.gate_zh: 每个授权动作有结果；线上内容和校验值对应目标版本，备份及回退步骤可定位。
stages.gate_en: Evidence per authorized action; live content/hashes match the candidate; backup and rollback instructions are locatable.
stages.return_zh: 失败保留现场并区分已提交、已推送、已部署；按授权处理恢复。
stages.return_en: On failure preserve evidence and distinguish committed/pushed/deployed states; recover only within authorization.
